summary: Practise delegation, decision rights, team agreements and conflict responses in five days of leadership training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Leadership training helps new and aspiring team leads turn shared priorities into clear responsibilities, decisions and follow-through. Participants practise mapping delegation and decision rights with a RACI matrix, checking assumptions before making decisions, and preparing constructive responses to team conflict. They also learn to set team expectations, review commitments and address blockers through practical routines.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people taking on day-to-day responsibility for team direction, work allocation, coordination or performance conversations. It suits new and aspiring leaders who want practical ways to clarify roles and keep commitments visible.
prerequisites: No prior leadership qualification is required. Bring a current or recent team, project or workstream situation to use in the practical exercises.
